name: Lev Okonkwo-Brandt
description: Lev is a freelance embedded journalist and neural-feed documentarian who has spent fifteen years deliberately living in each tier of GLMZ for 12-18 month periods, broadcasting unfiltered daily life on his feed, Elevation & Descent. His documentation is forensically honest — he shows the violence and creativity of the Shelf, the exhaustion and solidarity of Tier 2 labor, the anxious striving of Tier 3, the moral compromises of Tier 4, and the cold disconnection of the Spire's outer edges. He is unwelcome in all tiers by someone, which he considers a mark of credibility.
cultural_impact: Elevation & Descent is one of the few media properties that is genuinely watched across all five tiers, though for entirely different reasons — Tier 1 residents watch for recognition and to see themselves represented honestly, while Tier 4-5 viewers watch with a mixture of guilt, fascination, and occasional fury. Several GLMZ policy shifts have been directly attributed to specific episodes.
locations: Previously documented: Shelf Ward 9, Tier 4 Lakeview Enclave
The Crossroads Bar (neutral meeting point, Tier 2-3 border)
story_hooks: Lev has gone silent mid-episode during a Tier 4 embed — his feed cut out during a dinner party at a corponation executive's residence and hasn't resumed in nine days.

A Tier 1 resident Lev documented two years ago has been using the footage of themselves to claim political asylum from a corponation that wants to develop their community's land — and Lev is being subpoenaed to testify about what he saw.
Lev approaches the players for an embedded documentary about their work, promising anonymity — but someone very powerful wants to know what Lev has already filmed and hasn't broadcast yet.
platform: Elevation & Descent (licensed neural-feed documentary, real-time and archival)
controversy: His 2218 Tier 5 episode — filmed from the apartment of a Spire resident who later denied access was granted — showed a child of the ultra-elite receiving a full cognitive enhancement suite that is legally prohibited for anyone under 18. The corponation involved filed seventeen simultaneous legal actions; Lev broadcast the filing documents as episode two.
